Source [S1] explicitly demonstrates this by calculating `min_val` and `max_val` as the 5th and 95th percentiles (robust bounds) to avoid outliers, clipping the image to these values, normalizing the result to [0, 1], and then scaling it to [0, 255]. This matches every part of the claim.
